easy.def: Able to wait without getting upset.
easy.example: Be patient. It will be your turn soon.

more.def: Able to stay calm while waiting or when something is hard.
more.example: The patient teacher explained the problem again until everyone understood.

more.def: Strange or unusual in a way that makes you notice.
more.example: There was a peculiar smell coming from the science room.

easy.def: To say what you think will happen.
easy.example: I predict it will rain today.

more.def: To say what you think will happen in the future, using what you already know.
more.example: Scientists use clouds and wind to predict the weather.

more.def: To keep someone or something safe from harm.
more.example: The mother bird protected her eggs from the cold.
